exhibits.title: The Palace of Mind
exhibits.text: Welcome, keeper. Every chamber of this palace holds one piece of true knowledge, dressed in enchantment so that it may be walked through rather than merely read. Wings radiate from this Atrium; doors join ideas that follow one another; glowing portals join ideas that merely rhyme. Nothing here is decoration — every mirror, cauldron and statue is a working metaphor for something real.

exhibits.title: How to Walk
exhibits.text: Move with W, A, S, D and look with the mouse. Approach any exhibit and press E to study it closely; press E again or Escape to step back. Press M for the map of the palace, G for the constellation of ideas, and F to travel by Floo to any chamber you know the name of.

exhibits.title: Professor Aurelius Bramblestoke
exhibits.subtitle: Keeper of the Predictive Arts
exhibits.text: Ah — you've arrived. The castle grows as you learn, you know. Tonight the Divination Wing stands ready: four chambers on the art of predicting what is hidden. Mind the Mirror; it has a habit of showing students the gist of things. When you have learned something new in the wider world, send word, and the masons will raise another chamber by morning.
